    Finiteness conditions and the smaller-brick conclusion #

    Library versions, for left modules over A, of representation-finiteness and brick-finiteness (IsRepFinite, IsBrickFinite), the conclusion of Theorem A (HasSmallerBrick), and the consequence of Krull–Schmidt used in Proposition 4.7: over a representation-finite algebra only finitely many quotients by a simple submodule, and finitely many kernels of maps onto a simple module, occur up to isomorphism.
